sections.overall: What a show Grand Slam: Mexico was! The two big matches: Kyle Fletcher vs Mike Bailey and Will Ospreay vs Mark Davis led to decent gains for all 4. Another great week for AEW!
sections.mens: Kyle Fletcher not only moves to number 1 but regains his "Platinum" status (150+). A very select group have made it there! The multi-man matches led to some small losses but they were not as notable as the previously mentioned gains. Also welcome back Adam Page! In his time away, his rating naturally dropped but is already back in at #10. We do however lose Mark Briscoe from the rankings - wishing him a speedy recovery.
sections.womens: None of the three women's matches especially delivered this week. More was certainly expected from Persephone and Kris Statlander in their singles match.
sections.menstag: No straight up Men's Tag again but a few featured in multi-man matches.
sections.womenstag: Hyan & World featured on Collision against a new pairing. Plus we had the title rivals in the Trios on Dynamite. No major changes this week.
sections.trios: Another new Trios champs! Brodido & Page will not feature in the rankings until they have had a second match (hopefully soon!). Meanwhile The Demand reach a career high and retain their "Bronze" status. Hopefully their title loss does not mean they are out of the action for long.
